summary: Since the finding-an-opponent screen became small places (#377), a finished game shows its result with Find one row away (multiplayer-open-find) instead of on the same screen. A Synthetic User that had just finished a game no longer saw Find, went back to its spaces and idled, so it never looked for its next opponent (finding-opponents regression finding-opponents-synthetic-game-first-move-abort: syntheticLooking 0 where the model has 1). It now opens the search's hub from the result's row and finds an opponent there.
